description: Sign in when signedIn:false; otherwise acquire an MCP token silently, possibly from cache, and retain the current account and environment. This does not force token refresh, validate service access, or clear an HTTP 401. This signs in only; copilot_studio_select_environment establishes the cloud service connection. When signedIn is false, the browser prompt is the user's confirmation, so do not ask for separate approval in chat first. Set reauthenticate:true only after the user requests account change, agrees to a required interactive sign-in, or approves one interactive attempt after an MCP HTTP 401 repeats following successful silent acquisition; this will replace an existing signed-in session and clear its environment and setup plans. The account picker may select a different account or tenant; confirm the returned identity before selecting an environment. A new sign-in may not fix service permissions; if it is still rejected, stop/report rather than looping. Never automatically replay the failed operation. Do not call for an already-ready session merely to start another task, or just to select an environment. A transient token error is not a request to reauthenticate.

reauthenticate.description: Explicitly replace an existing sign-in after the user agrees. Default false preserves the current session.
